# aibris v0.12.1

This patch release closes the release gap between v0.12.0 (2026-08-30) and 
current `main` (2026-09-20), collecting 122 commits of internal refactoring, 
bug fixes, and documentation improvements.

## Highlights

- **Internal refactoring**: Domain logic migrated from `cmd/` to internal 
  packages for better modularity and testability (#530–#547)
  - `internal/scancache`: last-scan snapshot persistence and path identity
  - `internal/codexactivity`: Codex session-activity index and cache
  - `internal/worktree`: activity enrichment and Git cleanup-safety inspection
  - `internal/apfs`: local APFS snapshot listing and tmutil thinning
  - `internal/executor`: unified cleanup plan logic and worktree execution
  - `internal/cleanjson`: receipt execution
- **Worktree discovery improvements** (#528)
  - Support for `*-worktrees` containers (e.g., `proj-manager-worktrees`)
  - Linked sibling checkout discovery via `.git/worktrees/*/gitdir`
- **Bug fixes**
  - `clean --json --include-paths` now emits one argv per physical command 
    target (#525)
  - `clean --json` honors `--exclude` and emits exclusions (#513)
  - `--protect-path` properly protects outer owners when nested paths exist (#516, #518)
  - Homebrew formula publish EXIT trap fixed (#327)
- **Features**
  - Codex tmp L2 contract support (#529)
- **Documentation**
  - Repository layout improvements (docs moved to `docs/`, tests to `test/`) (#531)

## Compatibility impact

- [x] **No compatibility change.** Documented CLI flags, JSON fields,
  defaults, and exit behavior are unchanged.

CLI surface, JSON schema version (`1`), and default behavior remain 
identical to v0.12.0. All changes are internal refactoring or bug fixes.

## Upgrade and migration

No flag migration is required.

```bash
brew upgrade aibris
# or:
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.sh | bash -s -- v0.12.1
```

Existing `scan --json` / `clean --json` consumers are unaffected.

## Safety

All v0.12.0 safety guarantees remain unchanged:

- `plain-dir` and mixed-marker owners stay review-only
- Active worktrees, live agent state, and current working directory are protected
- `--apfs-snapshots` stays opt-in
- Default `clean --json` output stays path-redacted

The bug fixes improve safety by:
- Correctly protecting nested paths via `--protect-path`
- Properly honoring `--exclude` in all code paths
- Ensuring consistent argv generation for physical command targets

## Windows status

Windows archives remain **experimental**. The supported shape is the `amd64` /
`arm64` Windows zip archives cross-built by GoReleaser and listed in
`checksums.txt`. Native users verify the SHA-256 and place `aibris.exe` on
`PATH`; `install.sh` remains Unix-only. Pull-request CI builds and exercises
the native executable on `windows-latest`.

## Verification

Pre-tag verification passed `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, and the
Windows-status validator. PR #548 CI passed all checks (ubuntu-latest, 
macos-latest, windows-safety, release-build). The tagged release workflow 
will publish the six Darwin/Linux/Windows archives, `checksums.txt`, SPDX 
SBOMs, GitHub attestations, and the tap Formula update.
